recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical mid-century layout featuring two arched panels enclosed within a thin rectangular border. The left arch contains a vertical list of text on a tan background, while the right arch contains a soft-focus portrait. A monoline script header sits centered above the arches, breaking the top border line.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry between the two arched frames
Contrast between the flat tan text panel and the photographic depth of the portrait
Integration of the script header into the outer border line
Harmonious muted color palette connecting the tan, cream, and slate blue elements
coreInvariants: Arched top frames with double-line borders
Vertical centering of text within the left arch
Script typography positioned at the top center

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two identical arched windows occupy the central 80% of the canvas, with the portrait scaled to a head-and-shoulders crop.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The script header at the top center acts as the primary entry point, followed by the two balanced arches.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down from the script header, then left-to-right across the two arched panels.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Generous cream-colored margins around the central frame and between the two arches.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cream/Off-white background for the outer frame.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Slate blue for the thin border lines and script text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm tan for the text panel background.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, medium value palette typical of 1960s offset printing.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to muted earth tones and slate

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of monoline script and ultra-condensed sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Script: Continuous stroke, medium weight, upright slant, looped ascenders.
Sans-serif: Extremely high aspect ratio, flat sides, tight apertures, uniform stroke weight.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'g' in script has a large, rounded descender loop.
Uppercase letters in the list are uniform in height with no decorative serifs.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between organic, fluid script and rigid, vertical sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the upright, monolinear 60s script feel.
Captures the tall, narrow, flat-sided sans-serif aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a cream-colored square canvas with a thin slate-blue rectangular border. Inside, place two identical arched windows side-by-side. The left arch is filled with a flat, warm tan color. The right arch contains a soft-focus 1960s style portrait of a woman with a bouffant hairstyle. Leave the top center of the border line open for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a monoline script name in slate blue at the top center, overlapping the gap in the border. Inside the left tan arch, center a vertical list of song titles using a white, ultra-condensed sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Does the script text break the top border line?
Is the list text vertically centered in the left arch?
Is the color palette muted and vintage-appropriate?

mustRedesign: Record label logo at the bottom

mustAchieve: Legible but highly condensed list typography

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the script font is monolinear and not calligraphic.
Check that the arches have a double-line stroke detail.
Verify the cream background has a slight paper-like warmth.
Confirm the sans-serif text is significantly taller than it is wide.
recipe.reuseFormula: Symmetrical bifold arches + monoline script header + condensed list + muted 60s palette.
